billed-cost-on-unknown-attempt.json.why: Provider data for an unknown attempt settles it (7.5), so an unknown record never carries a billed cost.

estimated-evidence-on-relay-record.json.why: Estimated values come only from trace readers; a relay usage record never carries them (6.5).

fee-listed-twice.json.why: One entry per fee; a repeated fee_id would be counted twice when cost is recomputed (M2).

free-text-in-session-id.json.why: Identifiers admit no whitespace, so an ID field cannot carry prose (C2).

local-cost-as-measured-zero.json.why: A local model is metered but not billed: its cost is unavailable with not_billed, not a measured 0.

local-provider-on-relay-path.json.why: Local models are reached only by the sidecar directly, never through the relay (2, 5).

missing-message-hash-on-priced-response..why: A relay response priced from usage carries the keyed hash that keeps trace events from counting it twice (M4).

money-as-json-float.json.why: Money is integer nano-dollars; a JSON float such as 209000000.0 cannot hold exact money (6.4).

not-billed-on-relay-attempt.json.why: Only local models are not billed; marking a paid relay attempt not_billed would drop it from spend (B1).

openai-record-with-anthropic-speed.json.why: OpenAI has no speed parameter; a mis-mapped setting would be priced under the wrong rule (6.2, 6.3).

prompt-excerpt-extra-property.json.why: The record is closed: no field may carry prompt or response text (C2).

public-listener-with-device-id.json.why: Public-listener (Cursor) traffic authenticates with a virtual key and has no device (4, 5.1).

raw-speed-value-turbo.json.why: Price dimensions are enumerated; an unrecognized value is stored as null with unrecognized_value, never raw (C2, 6.3).

relay-retry-without-original.json.why: A relay retry is its own attempt with its own reservation and names the attempt it retries (7.2, B2).

settled-without-settled-at.json.why: A settled attempt carries its settlement time.

state-released.json.why: A released attempt sent no byte upstream, so it has no usage record (7.5).

unavailable-cost-given-as-zero.json.why: A cost that cannot be computed is null with a reason, never 0 nd (6.5).

unavailable-count-without-reason.json.why: An unavailable value must say why it is unavailable (6.5).

unavailable-given-as-zero.json.why: An unavailable count must be null with a reason; 0 would read as a measured zero (6.5).

unpriced-without-unpriced-dimensions.jso.why: An unpriced cost must name which price-book dimensions were missing (6.3, M5).

unrecognized-dimension-with-computed-cos.why: Unpriced, not guessed: an unrecognized speed makes the attempt unpriced, never a computed amount (6.3, B3).

usage-cost-on-interrupted-count.json.why: A cost computed from usage cannot rest on a count that was lost: that prices unavailable as zero (6.5).
